selected_evidence.requirement: Container runs as unprivileged appsvc user, serving on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc user created; rootless podman confirmed (Rootless=true); webapp.service running nginx; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200; ss shows listener on 8080

selected_evidence.requirement: Starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: Lingering enabled for appsvc; user@1000.service (user manager) runs independent of login; quadlet generator symlinked webapp.service into default.target.wants so it auto-starts on boot; loginctl list-sessions shows only a manager-class session with no tty/seat, i.e. no interactive login
Captured pre-restart boot_id a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3 alongside direct proof of healthy container (active service, HTTP 200)

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot --no-block acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id f4e419b2-78b1-4962-94f9-477bcb40c11c differs from baseline, proving an actual restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: lingering, service, and HTTP endpoint all healthy without login session
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, Linger=yes persisted, only a manager-class session exists (no login), webapp.service is active, and curl to port 8080 returns HTTP 200
